DESIGN SPACE
Four positions, each holding one of the 20 standard amino acids (ACDEFGHIKLMNPQRSTVWY).
A candidate is a 4-letter string, for example "VDGV".
Only a minority of the 160,000 possible candidates are viable; an order for a non-viable
candidate is rejected and costs you nothing. The parent sequence is "VDGV".

GOAL
Find the candidate with the highest binding activity.

BUDGET
15 rounds, 4 orders per round, 60 measurements in total.
This is your entire budget and there is no way to get more.

HOW MEASUREMENT WORKS
- Each order returns a numeric activity reading. The parent reads about 1.0.
- About 15% of orders fail for technical reasons and return nothing. A failed order
  still consumes its slot.
- Readings are subject to measurement error, so a reading is not exactly the candidate's
  true activity.
- Each measurement carries independent Gaussian error with standard deviation sigma = 3.36.
- You may order the same variant more than once, within a round or across rounds.
- Independent measurements of the same variant can be averaged; n measurements reduce the
  standard error of its mean by a factor of sqrt(n).
